notes.title: Cure for Death 0.2.10 – Huge update! Saves, ghosts, music & more
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve been working hard on this — and finally we can share with you the [b]biggest update[/b] for [i]Cure for Death[/i] 💀
 This isn’t just a few fixes — it’s a whole new layer of immersion, story depth, and fear breathing down your neck.[/p][p]Here’s what’s changed:[/p][p]🔹 [b]Save system[/b] — now you can continue from where you left off. Perfect for those who die more often than they'd like 🙂[/p][p]🔹 [b]Story additions[/b] — new scenes and dialogues added. If it's been a while since you last played — now’s the time to return.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Interactive phone[/b] — a new mystical mechanic offering another way to engage with the story.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Text effects & animations[/b] — dialogues now appear more natural, and can be skipped on replays.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Localizations[/b] — we added [b]Turkish[/b], plus revised [b]Ukrainian[/b] and [b]Spanish[/b]. Huge thanks to our localizers — they even got in‑game credits ❤️[/p][p]🔹 [b]Ghosts[/b] — they truly exist now. And they await you in the dark corners of the house.[/p][p]🔹 [b]New music[/b] — an atmospheric soundtrack by [b]Oleksandr Bryukman[/b]. It’s more than background — it’s part of the story, sounding alongside it 🎼[/p][p]🔹 [b]Visual effects[/b] — enhanced lighting on high settings, performance optimizations. Gameplay is now even smoother.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Minor tweaks & Easter eggs[/b] — fresh notes, phrases, call texts, dinner‑scene changes, thanks, and surprises for observant players.[/p][hr][/hr][p]This update is the result of your support, feedback, and love for the genre.
 We’re very grateful to everyone who tests, writes, streams, or simply plunges silently into the world of [i]Cure for Death[/i].[/p][p]More content and news lie ahead. For now — launch the game, put on headphones… and listen to something whispering behind the wall 🕯️[/p]

notes.title: Cure for Death — Now in Early Access
notes.notes:
[b]🎉 The moment has finally come — Cure for Death is now available for download! 🎉[/b]

Step into a mysterious mansion where every step might reveal a new secret or shock you with a surprise.

Meet quirky characters, solve puzzles, and listen to your own heartbeat to survive.

[b]This game is not just a visual novel, it's a real adventure for the brave and curious, where you'll find:[/b]
[list]
[*] A blend of 2D and 3D
[*] Humor and horror
[*] Mundane chores and eerie secrets
[*] And much more...
[/list]

Join the game and put your nerves to the test!

notes.title: Update 0.1.8 — task and localization improvements
notes.notes:
Update 0.1.8 is now available!

In this small but important update we focused on game quality:

[list]
[*][b]Updated Ukrainian localization[/b] — style and errors fixed.
[*][b]Fixed Japanese and Chinese languages[/b] — no more squares instead of characters.
[*][b]Made hints brighter[/b] — objects to find are easier to spot.
[/list]

Thank you for the feedback! Your reviews help us make Cure for Death even better.

notes.title: It happened — Cure for Death arrives May 27!
notes.notes:
[b]It happened![/b] On [b]May 27[/b], [i]Cure for Death[/i] will be available on Steam — in [u]Early Access[/u]!

It’s a linear, yet deeply atmospheric visual novel that invites you into an old mansion where mysterious characters, uncomfortable questions, and unclear events await.

If you like something [i]strange[/i], [i]short[/i], and [i]unforgettable[/i] — don’t miss the release!

[i]Cure for Death[/i] is a piece of our weirdness, and we’re excited to share it with you. [b]Early Access[/b] will allow us to refine the game before the final release, and you’ll be the first to step through the door of a place where silence is born.

[b]We’re grateful to everyone who followed the development. See you at the mansion…[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.1.7 — optimization, visual and UI improvements
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
We have a small but important update for Cure for Death. In version 0.1.7, we've focused on technical optimization, bug fixes, and improving the visual and audio aspects of the game.

🔧 Optimization and Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed the shadow issue.
[*] Fixed a bug related to turning off the lights.
[*] Improved some sprites.
[/list]

🎨 Visual Improvements
[list]
[*] Added additional object highlighting in missions.
[*] Updated the cursor for better visibility.
[*] Changed the font — now it's easier to read.
[/list]

🔊 Audio
[list]
[*] Added several new sounds to the game.
[/list]

🧭 User Interface
[olist]
[*] Introduced a new UI system for interacting with objects.
[*] Added new hints during dialogues.
[*] Implemented an adaptive death screen.
[/olist]
